1. THE PANTHEON GUARD IS DIRECTIONAL AND IS NOT A PIN. "the pantheon must not shrink", 145 -> 142. That assertion does not say "the pantheon is 145"; it says it may not get smaller. Your campaign ships bounded stellar topologies, and deities derive from celestial phenomena, so bounding the topology plausibly removes three of them. If that is intended, the guard is the wrong shape for a world where bounding is legitimate and it needs restating -- not re-pinning, since there is no number in it to move. If it is not intended, three deities went missing and that is the finding.

Your sky changes shortened a walk below the length its own test needs to say anything. Same family as everything else tonight: the test is refusing to pass while testing nothing.

   must build at least one scan that finds an emitter" -- on EMITTER_SEED, and

   `const RULE_FOUR_SEED: u64 = 28`. Your merge fails the same assertion on

   only one of them carrying a guard that could detect an emitter drought.
